statement: Tom's Hardware reports xAI/SpaceXAI is building a 1.2-gigawatt power plant to bring its installed GPU systems fully online.
why: Needing to build your own power plant to energize GPUs already on site says power, not silicon, is the gating constraint on deployed capacity.

impact.mechanism: If installed accelerators must wait on self-built generation, the lag between GPU delivery and revenue-producing operation lengthens for the whole build chain.

evidence.excerpt: is building 1.2-gigawatt power plant to bring systems fully online

confidence.basis: Headline-only evidence: the document states the full article body was not retrievable, and no timeline or completion date for the plant is given.

entity: xAI / SpaceXAI (Colossus 1 and Colossus 2 data centers)
